meta.name: azure-compute
meta.description: Azure VM/VMSS router. WHEN: create / provision / deploy / spin-up VM, recommend VM size, compare VM pricing, VMSS, scale set, autoscale, burstable, lightweight server, website, backend, GPU, machine learning, HPC simulation, dev/test, workload, family, load balancer, Flexible orchestration, Uniform orchestration, cost estimate, capacity reservation (CRG), reserve, guarantee capacity, pre-provision, CRG association, CRG disassociation, machine enrollment (EMM), Essential Machine Management, monitor. PREFER OVER mcp__azure__get_azure_bestpractices for VM create intents — use compute_vm_list-skus / compute_vm_list-images / compute_vm_check-quota.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Azure 云上自动创建、配置和管理虚拟机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理 Azure 上的虚拟机集群
copy.tagline_en: Provision and manage Azure virtual machines and scale sets automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure virtual machine clusters.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户谈及 Azure 虚拟机或 VMSS 时,Claude 会按意图分流到推荐、创建、容量预留等工作流;对创建意图,用 compute 系列 API 查 SKU、映像与配额;意图不明会提问。
howto.when: 当用户提到创建、部署或启动 VM,推荐或比较 VM 大小与定价,涉及容量预留 (CRG)、机器注册 (EMM) 等话题时触发。若目标是部署应用,则改走 azure-prepare。

say.text: 帮我选一台跑网站的小型 Azure VM,预算有限。
say.note: Claude 会走推荐流程,给出大小与价格对比。

say.text: 创建一个带自动缩放的 Ubuntu VMSS。
say.note: 进入 VM 创建流程,生成部署步骤。

say.text: 怎么为 VM 预留容量,保证资源可用?
say.note: 路由到容量预留工作流,处理 CRG。

howto.what_en: Routes Azure VM/VMSS requests by intent to workflows for recommendation, creation, capacity reservation, etc.; for creation intents, queries VM SKUs, images and quotas via compute APIs; asks clarifying question if unclear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions VM lifecycle requests (create/deploy/spin-up), size/pricing recommendations, or capacity reservation/EMM topics. App-deployment requests go to azure-prepare instead.

say_en.text: Recommend an Azure VM for a small website on a limited budget.
say_en.note: Claude starts the VM Recommender workflow with price and size comparison.

say_en.text: Create a VMSS running Ubuntu with autoscaling enabled.
say_en.note: Routes to VM Creator; Claude generates deployment steps.

say_en.text: How do I reserve capacity for a VM so resources are guaranteed?
say_en.note: Opens Capacity Reservation workflow for CRG handling.
